# Yuchen Water

Yuchen Water manufactures water filtration components, drinking-water systems and OEM/ODM product platforms in Haining, Zhejiang, China.

## E500-TS-1 (B/W) countertop RO water dispenser

Plumbed-in hot and cold reverse osmosis water dispenser with compressor cooling and intelligent control. OEM/private-label supply and two- or three-outlet configurations can be discussed. English display artwork is a customizable sample.

<!-- E600_S_MIN_LLMS_START -->
## E600-S-Min commercial RO water dispenser
- [Canonical English product](https://www.yuchensy.com/en/product-e600-s-min-commercial-ro-water-dispenser.html)
- Floor-standing dispenser for office and hospitality drinking-water projects; white or gray cabinet. Select 100G or 400G RO purification (listed purified-water flow: 0.26 or 1.05 L/min), a 5 L or 10 L hot tank, and optional cooling.
- Quick-change PP, CTO, T33 and RO membrane cartridges; long-term spare-parts support is paid. Installation requires inlet-water and drainage connections. Voltage and frequency can be customized.
- Samples, minimum order quantity and lead time require sales confirmation of project and customization requirements.
<!-- E600_S_MIN_LLMS_END -->
